claims.claim: SiamCTC improves representation robustness at diverse speaking rates in the reported experiments.
claims.limitations: Augmentation, language, CTC targets, downstream tasks, and rate range bound transfer; robustness is not universal recognition accuracy.

claims.claim: The paper reports competitive multilingual alignment and 6 ms average CPU phoneme inference on Galaxy devices.
claims.limitations: Device, language, phoneme inventory, transcript availability, and splits bound transfer; latency is not alignment quality.

claims.claim: The paper reports improved emotional accuracy and naturalness for unseen speakers across evaluated datasets.
claims.limitations: Labels, speaker coverage, out-of-domain definition, protocol, and identity metrics bound transfer; conversion does not establish consent.

claims.claim: The added components increase privacy in the tested attack, and target selection changes measured privacy.
claims.limitations: Attack, target pool, language, utility metric, and prosody definitions bound the result; attack reduction is not anonymity.

claims.claim: On NSC Part 2, reported WER falls from 30.86% to 12.19% after 10 hours of synthetic-data fine-tuning.
claims.limitations: Synthetic realism, rare-word list, decoder, beam settings, and WER denominator bound the claim.

claims.claim: The method raises reported MTWV from 0.015 to 0.504 on IndicSUPERB and exceeds the Marathi baseline.
claims.limitations: Language, script, ASR errors, query duration, and splits constrain transfer; script unification is not translation.

claims.claim: Four hours of harmful plus 150 hours of benign speech yields reported relative safety gains of 45–300% over baseline.
claims.limitations: Attack family, harm taxonomy, model, synthesis, and rubric bound the claim; refusal is not complete security.

claims.claim: The models report comparable ASR with 35% Conformer and 30% wav2vec2/HuBERT parameter reductions.
claims.limitations: Hardware latency, unfolding cost, family, task, and benchmark coverage bound transfer; fewer parameters is not automatically less energy.
